quests.title: Liyue: Theater Mechanicus

dialogue.t: Hello! Would you like to play a round of Theater Mechanicus?
Oh, never heard of it? Allow me to introduce it to you then. Theater Mechanicus is a kind of tabletop game invented by yours truly.
Do you see these things laid out on the table here? These are all important items used in Theater Mechanicus.
It may seem complicated, but you'll get the hang of it after you play a couple of times.
So, how about it? Would you like to give it a try?

dialogue.sit: Uh, well how much does it cost to play?

dialogue.t: No, not at all. It is the Lantern Rite, after all. Besides, I was hoping to collect everyone's initial impressions of the game.
So all it'll cost you to play is a single Xiao Lantern.
If you'd like to try, just bring me a Xiao Lantern and you'll be good to go!
C'mon, give it a try! I'll even let you play the first round for free and you can keep your Xiao Lantern.
